Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). did_you_know.fact: On June 14, 2025: Vipul Patel performs the first prostatectomy via transcontinental telesurgery on a man in Angola.
On June 14, 1959: Disneyland Monorail System, the first daily operating monorail system in the Western Hemisphere, opens to the public in Anaheim, California.
On June 14, 1949: Albert II, a rhesus monkey, rides a V-2 rocket to an altitude of 134 km (83 mi), thereby becoming the first mammal and first monkey in space.
June 14 is observed as World Blood Donor Day.
June 14 is observed as Liberation Day (Falkland Islands and South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands).
